summary: Where to install fixed gas detectors based on gas density, leak sources and airflow.
author: SWME Technical Staff

infographic.title: Where to Mount Gas Detectors
infographic.alt: Infographic showing gas detector placement heights for heavy, light and air density gases
steps: H2S, propane, butane: mount 0.3 to 0.5 m above floor or grade.
Methane, hydrogen, ammonia: mount near the ceiling or highest point.
CO and O2: mount in the breathing zone, about 1.5 m above floor.
Place detectors close to pumps, valves, flanges and compressor seals.
